headline: Arvind Kejriwal writes to EC, demands appointment of independent observers in New Delhi constituency
body_head: NEW DELHI: AAP supremo Arvind Kejriwal has alleged attack on his party workers ahead of the Delhi assembly polls and demanded that the Election Commission appoint independent observers in his New Delhi constituency. No immediate reaction was available from the BJP and the Delhi Police over Kejriwal's claims. In the letter, the former Delhi chief minister also cited some alleged incidents of attack on AAP workers in his New Delhi constituency. headline: Man shot dead in Delhi's Rohini; gang war angle suspected
body_head: NEW DELHI: A man identified as Sahil Solanki was shot dead in Delhi’s Rohini area on Saturday night, with police suspecting gang rivalry behind the killing. Sahil, who had recently been released from jail, was allegedly associated with the notorious Gogi gang. The rival Tillu gang is suspected to be behind the murder. The two gangs are known to be sworn enemies. Following the incident, fear has gripped the locality. Police said the investigation is underway and the accused are absconding. headline: Wanted criminal held in Delhi's Rohini
body_head: NEW DELHI: Delhi Police arrested a gangster after a brief exchange of firing in Rohini . The identified person namely Gaurav alias Monti was held on Friday. According to the police, he is an associate of jailed gangster Ashok Pradhan . Gaurav had been evading his arrest in the case of extortion, robbery and murder incident that took place in Qutubgarh . Information was received by the police on the whereabouts of the accused and a trap was laid. Upon spotting the accused, the police staff tried to stop him after which he opened fire on the police team. In retaliation, the police also fired. headline: Arvind Kejriwal says AAP van attacked; Delhi Police request formal complaint
body_head: NEW DELHI: Delhi Police on Sunday assured Arvind Kejriwal of strict legal action after he posted on X a clip of men seen encircling AAP's campaign van and tearing down the party's posters. The New Delhi DCP, responding to Kejriwal's post, claimed that "no PCR call or complaint was received in police station". The top cop assured strict legal action once the formal complaint was registered. "No PCR call or complaint received in police station. It is requested that a formal complaint may be lodged in the Police station and we assure strict legal action," the Delhi police said in a reply to the AAP chief's post where he claimed that Union home minister Amit Shah "was behind the incident". headline: CJI N V Ramana expresses serious concern over shootout in Delhi
body_head: NEW DELHI: Chief Justice of India N V Ramana on Friday expressed serious concern over the firing incident at Rohini Court complex in Delhi in which two assailants in lawyers attire gunned down gangster Jindra Gogi, who was in judicial custody. CJI Ramana wanted to visit the scene of the incident and take stock of the security arrangements inside the court complex but was advised against visiting the crime scene. headline: One criminal killed in encounter in Delhi's Rohini, 2 cops injured
body_head: NEW DELHI: One criminal was killed in an encounter in the Begum Pur area of Rohini in the national capital on Friday. As many as two police personnel received minor injuries and one criminal was killed in an encounter in Rohini, informed Delhi Police. Further details are awaited.

body_head: In a dramatic shootout inside Delhi's Rohini court, three persons, including a dreaded gangster, were killed on Friday. Here's how it happened: - Delhi Police personnel brought gangster Jitendra Gogi to produce him before a court in Rohini. - They shot dead the most-wanted gangster Jitendra Gogi in a corridor of the court as people heard multiple gunshots. - The two attackers were from a rival gang. - The attackers were also gunned down in the shootout. - Gogi was arrested in April under Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act by Delhi Police’s Special Cell. headline: Late-night storm fells over 80 trees, outer and south Delhi worst hit
body_head: New Delhi: With very strong winds sweeping the city on the intervening night of Monday and Tuesday, a large number of trees toppled over and parts of some buildings collapsed in the city. While few waterlogging complaints were received by the capital’s 12 municipal zonal offices, at least 81 cases of uprooting of trees were reported. Outer Delhi areas and parts of south Delhi like Najafgarh faced the maximum impact while East Delhi areas saw few complaints. In North Delhi Municipal Corporation jurisdiction areas, 41 complaints of tree falling, with maximum damage in outer Delhi areas like Rohini and Narela, were reported. headline: 49mm rain, traffic chaos, Sawan Shivratri rush, political rivals at wedding reception: What is trending in Delhi today
body_head: N New Delhi: Delhi is juggling a familiar mix of monsoon disruption, religious movement, civic action, court rulings, politics and a major international sporting event on Tuesday. Around 49mm of rain recorded in the capital has once again brought waterlogging and traffic snarls into focus, with more showers expected to keep commuters on alert. The final phase of the Kanwar Yatra ahead of Sawan Shivratri is adding another layer of congestion, with several major routes facing restrictions and diversions. headline: Nirbhaya gang-rape case judge retires from HC
body_head: New Delhi: Delhi High Court judge Justice Yogesh Khanna, who awarded death penalty to the four convicts in the Nirbhaya gang-rape case as a judicial officer in 2013, Saturday demitted office after a tenure of seven years. Justice Khanna became a permanent judge of the high court on November 8, 2016. As an additional sessions judge, Justice Khanna had, on September 13, 2013, handed capital punishment to the four convicts in the brutal gang-rape and murder case, saying it fell in the rarest of rare category as the crime was committed against a 23-year-old woman in a "beastly" and "hair-raising" manner. body_head: NEW DELHI: Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) MLA and candidate from Rithala, Mohinder Goyal , was attacked during a rally on Saturday, causing him to fall unconscious, according to the Delhi Police . Goyal is currently receiving treatment at Ambedkar Hospital in Rohini. The police received a PCR call at around 11.15am and quickly reached the location. An official stated, "We had received a call that AAP MLA Mohinder Goyal has been assaulted and he has fallen unconscious." AAP MP Sanjay Singh accused the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of orchestrating the attack. Singh took to X, alleging, "BJP is losing badly in Delhi and in frustration, it has resorted to violence. headline: Delhi: Gangster aide held after shootout in Rohini
body_head: NEW DELHI: A member of the notorious Ashok Pradhan gang was arrested on Friday night after a brief exchange of fire with police in north west Delhi ’s Rohini. The accused, Gaurav alias Monti, was leading the operations of the gang in the capital. He was also declared a ‘bad character’ of Bawana police station. DCP (Rohini) Pranav Tayal said: “Information was received on Friday night that the accused would be coming near Rohini Sector 37. Sub-inspector Chetan along with his team laid a trap. headline: Delhi police arrest man for looting 4 kgs gold from jeweller in Telangana
body_head: NEW DELHI: Delhi Police arrested a man who, along with his associates, looted four kilogrammes of gold from a jeweller in Telangana and shot at two people during the robbery, officials said on Wednesday. Sumit Dagar was declared a proclaimed offender in a murder case in Delhi after he did not surrender before the court on March 30, 2022, they said. On March 1, 2019, Dagar and his four associates killed Imran in Delhi over an old rivalry, police said. "After killing Imran, he was arrested and granted parole. headline: Delhi court sends gangster Deepak 'Boxer' to 8-day police custody
body_head: NEW DELHI: A Delhi court on Wednesday sent gangster Deepak "Boxer" , who was arrested in Mexico and brought to India this morning, to eight-day police custody in a fake passport case. In spite of the Delhi Police's request for 14 days of custody, the court only granted it for eight. He was presented to the judge while being closely guarded inside the Patiala House Courts ' lockup. Deepak Pahal , also known as "Boxer," was apprehended earlier this week in Cancun, Mexico, as he attempted to enter the US illegally with plans to run his organized crime organization from there. headline: Delhi: Peaceful protest in Rohini over alleged poor treatment of dogs at shelter
body_head: NEW DELHI: Around 150 people staged a protest outside a dog shelter home in Delhi's Rohini area on Friday, alleging that the animals housed there were not being treated properly, the Delhi Police said on Saturday morning. According to the police, demonstrators claimed that due to alleged negligence, several dogs at the shelter had died. The protestors demanded immediate action to ensure proper care of the animals. Officials stated that to address the concerns raised, a lawyer and two representatives from the protest group were allowed to enter the shelter premises for verification. headline: Delhi: Driver held from Rohini for faking robbery of Rs 20 lakh
body_head: NEW DELHI: A 24-year-old driver was arrested for allegedly fabricating a robbery of Rs 20 lakh in north Delhi's Civil Lines area, police said on Saturday. The accused has been identified as Pawan Kumar, a resident of Rohini and a native of Jharkhand, they said. On Thursday, one Sushil Aggarwal, who has a business of grains, had made a complaint with police alleging a robbery. In his complaint he wrote, that he had sent his driver Kumar to drop Rs 20 lakh at his nephew's office in Netaji Subhash Place on Wednesday, police said. headline: Two BJP MLAs marshalled out of Delhi assembly for the day
body_head: NEW DELHI: BJP MLAs Vijender Gupta and O P Sharma were marshalled out of the Delhi assembly for the day by the speaker for allegedly obstructing the AAP members from raising law-and-order and other issues in the House. The two opposition MLAs objected when the ruling Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) legislators attacked the Centre over the law-and-order situation in the national capital. Pravin Kumar, the AAP MLA from Jungpura, raised the issue of the stabbing of a teenager in his constituency and demanded that the Delhi Police commissioner be summoned to the House and answer about the law-and-order situation. headline: Juvenile apprehended for killing woman in Delhi's Rohini
body_head: NEW DELHI: A juvenile was apprehended for allegedly killing a woman and robbing her of her valuables in northwest Delhi's Rohini area, police said on Saturday. On February 7, the body of a woman with stab wounds was found inside a park in Shahbad Dairy area, a senior police officer said. During investigation, police apprehended a juvenile from Rohini Sector-28 near Nahar Road , the officer said. It emerged that the minor was a resident of Shahbad Dairy and he and his friends had gone to Jaipur where they started working in a factory, they said. headline: Lok Sabha polls: Delhi voters focus more on street crime, traffic woes, better infra
body_head: NEW DELHI: Law and order, traffic management and street crimes define a metropolis. They are among the prime indicators of a city’s ratings in terms of liveability. Usually, these would be electoral issues in assembly polls. But with the city’s police force controlled by central govt, law and order and traffic congestion are exercising the people's minds for the Lok Sabha elections. Voters TOI spoke to talked about the frequent snatchings, robberies and rising instances of extortions in Delhi. Crimes against women were another concern as were incidents involving gangs. headline: Blast in Delhi: Explosion reported outside CRPF school in Rohini
body_head: NEW DELHI: A mysterious blast shook the area near CRPF School in Sector 14, Rohini , on Sunday. The blast was powerful enough to damage the school wall, nearby shop windows, and a parked car. No injuries were reported. The police received a PCR call informing them of the blast around 7.47am, prompting officers to rush to the scene. Upon arrival, they found a damaged school wall emitting a foul smell, along with shattered windows and a damaged car. body_head: NEW DELHI: Two men were arrested in north Delhi's Rohini with drugs worth Rs 2 crore in their possession, police said on Saturday. Police were tipped off to the presence of Manish, 34, a history-sheeter, at Rohini. They intercepted a car in which Manish and his associate Tinku were travelling and arrested them, said deputy commissioner of police (crime) Vichitra Veer. Around 1.3 kg of fine-quality heroin, worth around Rs 2 crore in the international market, was recovered from the duo, he said. headline: Centre unable to maintain law and order in Delhi: AAP on school blast
body_head: NEW DELHI: The AAP on Sunday said the blast near a school in Delhi has exposed the "crumbling" law and order in the city and shows that the BJP-led central government is unable to fulfil its responsibility of keeping the Delhiites safe. The BJP spends most of its time obstructing the work of the elected government in Delhi instead, Chief Minister Atishi said in a post on X in Hindi. Responding to the Aam Aadmi Party's allegations, BJP senior leader Vijender Gupta accused AAP of "playing politics" and also held Chief Minister Atishi's statement "irresponsible." headline: Woman injured in celebratory firing in Delhi's Rohini
body_head: NEW DELHI: A 36-year-old woman was injured allegedly during a celebratory firing in Rohini Sector 20 early on Monday, police said, adding a call reporting the incident was received around 12.50 am. The injured woman was identified as Asha. Asha's relative has been arrested in the case. She got hit by a bullet at a party organised for the birth of her cousin Shiva's child, said deputy commissioner of police (Rohini) Guriqbal Singh Sidhu. "A case of attempt to murder has been registered in this regard," the officer said. Shiva, the prime suspect in the case, was on the run since the incident. body_head: New Delhi: A day after a bomb blast near a school in Rohini, Delhi minister Saurabh Bharadwaj on Monday raised concerns about "deteriorating" law and order situation in the city during the festive season, when the markets are bustling with activity. BJP countered his charges, saying AAP was trying to "divert" attention from its failures. headline: Fire breaks out at cyber crime police station in Delhi's Rohini, none injured
body_head: NEW DELHI: A fire broke out at Delhi Police's cyber crime police station in Rohini on Wednesday, officials said. No injuries have been reported in the incident so far, they said. A call about the blaze on ground floor of the police station was received at 3 pm following which five fire tenders were rushed to the spot, officials said. Atul Garg, director, Delhi Fire Service, said a spark from a computer system placed inside the station led to the fire in which essential documents and office records were gutted.

headline: Delhi: Ex-serviceman working in school goes missing from Rohini
body_head: NEW DELHI: Delhi Police has registered a case of kidnapping after an ex-serviceman went missing from Rohini. His daughter told police that her father was working with a Delhi government school for the last three years. “He usually returns home between 1.30pm and 2pm but did not come home on Monday,” she said. The complainant said 10-15 days ago, her father had told them about being followed by some people. She claimed the family has received threatening messages, including a photo of a banned organisation’s logo from his phone number. Deputy commissioner of police (Rohini) Guriqbal Singh Sidhu said investigators had found some leads.

headline: 'Amit Shah has made Delhi a gangster and extortion capital': Arvind Kejriwal
body_head: NEW DELHI: Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) national convener Arvind Kejriwal launched a scathing attack on Union Home Minister Amit Shah , allegedly accusing him of making Delhi the "gangster and extortion capital" of India. Speaking to the media in Delhi, Arvind Kejriwal criticised the deteriorating law and order situation in the capital, stating that in the past one to two years, there has been a significant increase in gang violence, extortion calls to businessmen and frequent shootings. He further compared the current situation to the underworld dominance in Mumbai in the 1990s. "In the last one to two years, the law and order in Delhi has been deteriorated. headline: Two brothers held with heroin worth Rs 1 cr from Delhi's Rohini
body_head: NEW DELHI: Two siblings were arrested by the Delhi Police on Monday with 915 grams of heroin worth more than Rs 1 crore in the international market in their possession, an officer said. The two men were identified as Tej Singh, 27, and Subedar Singh, 20, both residents of Nihal Vihar of Nangloi area, special commissioner of police (Crime) Ravindra Singh Yadav said. According to a tip-off, the two brothers were supposed to come to Sector 23-24 red light in Rohini with a consignment of heroin for distribution, he said. headline: 4 held for theft at Rohini temple
body_head: NEW DELHI: Four members of a gang that allegedly burgled donation box of Ram temple have been arrested in Rohini. The accused have been identified as Rahul alias Macchi (29), Mohit (22), Brijesh Verma (23) and Jitender Kumar (25), all residents of Rohini Sector-7, police said. With their arrest, five recent cases of burglaries have been worked out. Police seized Rs. 11,973 and tools used in the commission of crime from the accused persons.

headline: Abhilash Thapliyal: For me, the most exciting thing in Delhi was to have chuski or barf ka gola
body_head: After wrapping up the shoot for Maidaan last month, Abhilash Thapliyal has been in and out of the capital, visiting his home frequently between his shoots to attend to his mother and sister, who were undergoing medical treatment. The actor said that being in Delhi in summer reminded him of his childhood days when he would visit the city during vacations. He told us, “Since my father was in the Army , we kept moving from one city to the other, but during summer vacations I would always visit my grandparents’ place in Mayapuri in Delhi. body_head: Manoj Chaurasia Patna: A day after former CM Rabri Devi refused to vacate her official residence at 10, Circular Road, her daughter Rohini Acharya on Sunday openly challenged the Bihar govt to evict the family by force and accused it of pursuing “vendetta politics”. “Agar himmat hai toh jabran bungalow khali karwaye sarkar (If the govt has guts, it should vacate the bungalow forcibly),” Rohini wrote in a social media post. headline: Cops intensify patrolling in Rohini, arrest 27, detain 613
body_head: New Delhi: Delhi Police detained 613 people during an intensified patrolling conducted in Rohini on Sept 15. Based on suspicion, they were detained for verification under Delhi Police Act. The exercise, which took place from 6 pm to 10 pm, also saw the cops impound 127 vehicles under Delhi Police Act and take action against 70 people under Excise Act. Three people were arrested under the Arms Act. Twenty-four people were arrested under preventive sections of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. headline: Fraudster who duped Mumbai man of Rs 72,000 held in Delhi
body_head: MUMBAI: The cyber cell of Ghatkopar police has arrested a 30-year-old man from Haryana who was allegedly part of the cyber cheating gang that duped a Ghatkopar resident of Rs 72,000. Within minutes of the money being siphoned off from the victim's account, the accused withdrew it from an ATM in Delhi and switched off his mobile phone. However, the fraudster’s IMEI number helped police in tracking his location when he inserted another SIM in the same mobile handset. The accused, Pravin Harbans Singh was nabbed by a Ghatkopar team with the help of Delhi Police from Rohini in Delhi. headline: Delhi Police destroys illicit drugs worth more than 3k crore
body_head: New Delhi: Delhi Police on Thursday destroyed over 1,629.4 kg of seized illicit drugs valued at Rs 3,274.5 crore in the international market. The destruction marked the culmination of the Nasha Mukt Bharat Pakhwada (Drug-Free India Fortnight), observed from June 12 to June 26. The destruction of the narcotics was done at the Biotic Waste Solutions in Jahangirpuri and was attended by the lieutenant governor and top brass of Delhi Police. The contraband included 961.9 kg of ganja, 542.9 kg of cocaine, 6 kg of heroin, 3 kg of charas, 5.4 kg of opium, and 18 kg of alprazolam powder seized by the crime branch and special cell. headline: 2 Nepalese among 4 held for cyber fraud
body_head: Jaipur: Four men, including two Nepalese nationals and two Delhi residents, were arrested from a city hotel for their involvement in a cyber fraud operation with links to Chinese cybercriminals. The gang is believed to have facilitated fraudulent transactions worth Rs 24.4 crore, with complaints registered on the national cybercrime reporting portal from several states, including Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Kerala, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Telangana. Police identified the accused as Lal Dorge Tamang and Suaj Tamang from Nepal, and Pawan Jain and Abbu Shahma from Delhi. The arrests were made following an FIR lodged earlier in 2025. headline: Lust For Power: 1.5k Convicted In 4 Years
body_head: New Delhi: Over 1,500 people have been convicted of electricity theft in Delhi in the last four years, figures shared by power discoms in Delhi shown. Distribution companies have been battling power theft for years. It causes them major revenue losses, restricts infrastructure upgrades and adds unpaid load to the grid, leading to outages and higher technical losses, besides posing safety risks. The data, however, shows that a sustained enforcement drive against electricity theft can lead to positive results. headline: Delhi LG VK Saxena okays review petition against acquittal of Chhawla gang rape and murder accused
body_head: NEW DELHI: LG VK Saxena has approved filing of a review petition in the Supreme Court against the acquittal of the three accused earlier convicted and awarded death sentence by the trial court and High Court of Delhi for the gruesome rape and murder of a 19-year old girl in south-west Delhi's Chhawla in February, 2012. Sources in Delhi government's home department say the LG has also approved the appointment of solicitor general Tushar Mehta and additional SG Aishwariya Bhati to represent the case before the Supreme Court. body_head: New Delhi: In a joint operation by Delhi and Jharkhand police, four minor girls were on Monday rescued from a placement agency accommodation in northwest Delhi's Shakurpur. They told cops they were brought to the city to be employed as domestic helpers. According to sources, a human trafficking case was registered in Sahebganj, Jharkhand, in 2023. headline: Neighbour held for raping girl in Rohini
body_head: New Delhi: A three-year-old girl was allegedly sexually assaulted by her 25-year-old neighbour in Rohini's Begumpur on Monday. The accused has been taken into custody by police. According to DCP (Rohini) Guriqbal Singh Sidhu, "Local police immediately reached the spot. headline: ‘3 Delhi areas most vehicle theft-prone zones in NCR’
body_head: NEW DELHI: Bhajanpura in east, Uttam Nagar in west, and Rohini in north Delhi are the most vehicle theft prone areas in the National Capital Region (NCR), according to a recent study. headline: Stolen SUVs from Delhi being used to get around Bihar’s liquor ban
body_head: NEW DELHI: A large number of SUVs stolen at gunpoint in Delhi are being taken to Bihar and used for bootlegging in the dry state. One such racket being run by a commerce graduate from Bihar was busted by Delhi Police’s Crime Branch. The gang had committed a series of carjackings. Three vehicles, two Innova and a Creta, were looted in the first fortnight of October. The arrested man, Ashish Rai alias Prince (30), belongs to Siwan. He was nabbed by a team comprising inspector Alok Rajan and others from the special operations squad. His associates, Ravi Pandey, Swet Singh and Rajbir, are also from Siwan. headline: Youth stabbed to death in Delhi's Rohini area, 3 held
body_head: NEW DELHI: Three suspects were detained after a 22-year-old man was allegedly stabbed to death in Sector-17 in Delhi's Rohini area following an old enmity . The incident was reported from KNK Marg police station area. The youth was immediately rushed to the hospital after the attack, but doctors declared him brought dead. Police have registered a case under relevant sections of the law and have initiated an investigation. Three suspects connected to the crime have been detained for questioning. Initial investigations indicate a history of enmity between the deceased and the alleged perpetrators, though the specifics of the motive and circumstances remain under investigation. headline: Delhi: Two women held for ruckus at police station in Rohini
body_head: NEW DELHI: Two women have been arrested for allegedly thrashing and breaking the mobile phone of two sub-inspectors in Rohini on Friday evening, police said. The accused, Alka (29) and Hemlata (29), created a furore and manhandled a sub-inspector at a police station . Both of them claimed to be the wife of one Mahesh Barwa, who was arrested in a case earlier. A case under sections 186 (obstructing public servant in discharge of public functions), 353 (assault or criminal force to deter public servant from discharge of his duty), 34 (acts done by several persons in furtherance of common intention) and 427 (mischief causing damage to the amount of fifty rupees) of IPC was registered.

headline: Sakshi murder case: Accused Sahil sent to 2-day police custody
body_head: NEW DELHI: Sahil, the accused in the brutal murder of a minor girl in Delhi's Shahbad Dairy area, was on Tuesday remanded to two-day police custody by the Rohini Court. According to reports, due to security reasons, Sahil was produced before Duty Magistrates early on Tuesday morning. Duty Metropolitan Magistrate Jyoti Nain granted two days' remand after hearing the submissions of Delhi Police . Delhi Police requested the remand of Sahil, citing two reasons: firstly, the weapon used in the murder had not been recovered yet, and secondly, Sahil had been providing inconsistent statements that needed to be investigated and verified. Sahil was arrested from Bulandhshahr by Delhi Police on Monday.

body_head: NEW DELHI: A 19-year-old youth is battling for his life after he was stabbed repeatedly in the neck in northwest Delhi’s Rohini for allegedly being unable to repay a loan of Rs 2,000. headline: Rohini court shootout: Shots fired within minutes, seemed like terror attack, recall witnesses
body_head: NEW DELHI: Hours after the shocking shootout in Delhi's Rohini court which killed three persons, eyewitnesses recalled that at first, the incident seemed like a terror attack as gunshots rang out in staccato bursts, with people scrambling helplessly for cover. headline: DCW issues summons to Delhi Police over video showing children selling liquor
body_head: NEW DELHI: The Delhi Commission for Women (DCW) on Thursday issued summons to the city police over a video purportedly showing children selling illegal liquor and ganja. headline: Delhi: Tata Power to conduct Lok Adalat on theft cases
body_head: NEW DELHI: Tata Power distribution company will organise a special Lok Adalat to settle electricity theft cases on Sunday. In a statement, the company said it will be conducting the session, in association with the Delhi State Legal Services Authority, at two locations. Cases that are either pending in any court or are yet to be filed will be taken up by the Lok Adalat. Consumers desirous of settling their power theft cases can either attend in person or through their authorised representatives carrying an authorisation letter, photo ID and a copy of their theft bill. headline: The verdict: Security upped at Delhi's Rohini court, chinks remain
body_head: NEW DELHI: Security has been intensified at the Rohini district courts when it reopened for the public on Monday after last Friday’s shootout in which notorious gangster Jitender Gogi was killed in a courtroom. While there are still some chinks in the armour, the cops, bar associations and judicial members are working on a foolproof security plan. The shootout exposed the loopholes in the security at the Rohini courts, and all faulty metal detectors and X-ray machines were replaced. Entry to the court has been restricted and entry points specified for visitors.
